value.name: BlueTopo Relief
value.description: Shaded relief of the seafloor from NOAA's BlueTopo, the best available depth data blended into one surface and updated as new surveys arrive. Covers most U.S. coastal waters and Puerto Rico.

value.name: EOxCloudless Satellite Imagery
value.description: Cloud-free satellite image of the whole world from Sentinel-2 photos taken in 2025, about 10 m per pixel. Shows coastlines, reefs, shallows and islands as they look from above. Free for non-commercial use only; charter and other commercial boats need a licence from EOX.

value.name: NWS Radar – Continental US
value.description: Rain and thunderstorm radar for the lower 48 states and nearby coastal waters. A new image about every 2 minutes, with the last 2 hours available for playback.

value.name: NWS Storm & Special Marine Warnings
value.description: Active tornado, severe thunderstorm, flash flood and Special Marine Warning areas for all U.S. waters. Lines up with the NWS radar loop.
